Digital Diagnostics

Digital Diagnostics

Every serious treatment starts with accurate diagnostics — digital tools reveal what a routine exam alone cannot.

Ask on WhatsApp

About the treatment

3D CBCT gives a complete view of bone structure, while an intraoral scanner delivers precise measurements without the discomfort of traditional impressions.

Who it's for

  • —You're preparing for implants or surgery
  • —You need a detailed bite analysis
  • —You want the full picture of your dental health

Benefits

High precision

A quick, comfortable process

The basis for any treatment path

How we work

01

Consultation

We listen to your goals and concerns, review your overall oral health, and answer every question before anything else happens.

02

Digital diagnostics

Where relevant, we use 3D CBCT imaging and intraoral scanning to see the full picture with precision, not guesswork.

03

Personal treatment plan

Based on the diagnostics, we build a clear, staged treatment plan and walk you through what each step is for.

04

Treatment

We carry out the treatment according to plan, using modern technology and paying close attention to your comfort throughout.

05

Follow-up

We monitor how you're healing, schedule check-ins, and stay reachable if anything comes up afterward.

Technology used

CBCT 3D Diagnostics

A three-dimensional scan that shows the complete structure of the jawbone.

Intraoral Scanning

A precise digital model of your teeth, without traditional impression material.
